title: GCP Untagged Compute Instance

compliance.assurance_rationale: Saved search evidence for AU-2 when alert outputs are archived.

controlTest.positiveScenario: Replay sample `google:gcp:audit` events with `eventName="RunInstances" OR eventName="StartInstances"` into `index=gcp`. Confirm UC-4.4.66 returns >=1 row and the alert fires.
controlTest.negativeScenario: Replay benign `google:gcp:audit` traffic without `eventName="RunInstances" OR eventName="StartInstances"`. Confirm UC-4.4.66 returns zero rows and the alert does not fire.

dataSources: `index=gcp` sourcetype=`google:gcp:audit` collected via Splunk cloud TA for GCP; validate ingest with `| stats count by sourcetype`.

index=gcp sourcetype="google:gcp:audit" eventName="RunInstances" OR eventName="StartInstances"

description: UC-4.4.66 — GCP Untagged Compute Instance: queries Google Cloud `google:gcp:audit` for `RunInstances`, `StartInstances` and returns actor, resource, and region context for inventory review and change validation.
value: On Google Cloud, missing governance tags for 'GCP Untagged Compute Instance' break cost allocation, environment scoping, and incident routing—delaying containment when resources cannot be classified quickly. UC-4.4.66 drives high-priority inventory alerting before customer-impacting drift.
implementation: Configure required cloud inputs per provider guide; index=gcp sourcetype=google:gcp:audit.
visualization: Dashboard panel, alert, and weekly compliance report.
knownFalsePositives: Approved change windows; documented automation service principals; sandbox accounts excluded via lookup.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=gcp`.
• Install and configure Splunk cloud TA for GCP with the modular input for `google:gcp:audit`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.4.33.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `protoPayload.methodName` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Configure required cloud inputs per provider guide; index=gcp sourcetype=google:gcp:audit.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=gcp sourcetype="google:gcp:audit" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=gcp sourcetype="google:gcp:audit" eventName="RunInstances" OR eventName="StartInstances"
| table _time protoPayload.methodName protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail resourceName
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.4.66_gcp_untagged_compute_ins_66"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `google:gcp:audit` in `index=gcp` to detect gcp untagged compute instance. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the GCP Logs Explorer console for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `protoPayload.methodName` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_4_66_alert` with severity aligned to `high` criticality. Dashboard: Dashboard panel, alert, and weekly compliance report..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Splunk cloud TA for GCP and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch cloud logs for signs of gcp untagged compute instance so your team catches problems in your online services before customers or auditors do.
